ambient_events: The great trunk pipe groans as something far away shifts its load of water.
The sound rolls down the pipe and out at you, low and enormous and patient.
Condensation beads the curved iron overhead and lets go, one fat drop at a time.
description: A stretch of the old cast-iron trunk main, big enough to walk upright in, its seams furred with a century of mineral scale. The metal complains constantly — a deep structural groan that travels the length of the pipe and makes it impossible to tell how far off anything really is. The floor slopes steadily south, and down.
name: Groaning Main
